title: Trump urged to see Ukraine war devastation - Zelensky
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky urged US counterpart Donald Trump to visit his country to better understand the devastation wrought by Russia's invasion.

title: Ukraine war latest: Russian attack is 'signal' to US and Ukraine - as 34 killed and dozens injured
description: At least 34 people have been killed in a Russian missile strike on Ukraine's northeastern city of Sumy. That comes less than 48 hours after Donald Trump's envoy met Vladimir Putin in Russia for more talks on ending the war. Follow the latest below.

title: Russia's strikes make a mockery of US talks on Ukraine - with Putin seemingly risking Trump's patience
description: At least 34 people, including two children, were killed after a Russian strike on the Ukrainian city of Sumy on Sunday. Putin doesn't seem to mind if that makes a mockery of US-led talks on ending the war.

title: Civilian deaths in Sumy attack may force Washington to get tough with Putin
description: Talks between US and Russia continue unabated as attacks on Ukraine’s cities appear to have stepped up

title: Kremlin says instant results not possible after Trump demands Ukraine progress
description: Trump tells Russia to ‘get moving’ as envoy holds talks for peace deal in Ukraine with Putin on Friday

title: Missile strike on Ukraine's Sumy kills 21, injures over 80 even as Russia-US diplomacy for truce continues
description: The timing of the missile strike is key, coming just two days after US President Donald Trump's special envoy for Ukraine, Steve Witkoff, visited Moscow and held talks with Vladimir Putin in St Petersburg

title: Ukraine war latest: Russian bomb attack on Kupiansk injures four - as Trump says Ukraine talks 'going okay'
description: Donald Trump has said people will "find out soon" where discussions are when it comes to the Russia-Ukraine war. Meanwhile, a Russian-guided bomb has hit a house in the northeastern Ukrainian town of Kupiansk. Follow the latest on the Ukraine war.

title: Talks on Russia-Ukraine peace deal 'going fine'
description: US President Donald Trump has said that talks aimed at ending the war in Ukraine may be going OK, but "there's a point at which you just have to either put up or shut up."

title: US asks Ukraine for control of strategic gas pipeline linked to Russia: Report
description: The pipeline stretches from the town of Sudzha in western Russia all the way to the Ukrainian city of Uzhhorod, near the EU border with Slovakia. It's about 750 miles (1,200 kilometres) long and was built during the Soviet era
